title: Fragile visual memory is a window on seeing without access

statements.text: Iconic memory and fragile visual short-term memory may show perception without immediate cognitive access: items held there have been processed up to figure-ground organization and feature binding, and a cue can bring them over the report threshold.

sources.quote: iconic memory and fragile VSTM could form a window on 'perception without immediate cognitive access'
then iconic storage can be seen as a window into the contents of phenomenal awareness
